title: tc-run-estimate
description:
What a bulk run will cost before it starts – cells, tokens, web lookups, a cost range and the time, where the money
goes, the budget left, a sample run and a spend cap.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – what the run is

rows.description: How many rows the run fills

columns.description: The AI columns it fills, each with its own averages if they differ from the run's

model.description: The model and its prices per million tokens

lookups.description: Web lookups per cell, for columns that don't say

spread.description: How far the cost may land either side of the estimate, as a share (0.25 is ±25%)

budget.description: The budget left, in `currency`; unset hides the budget

sample.description: Run on the first `sampleRows` rows first. Changed by its checkbox unless a tc-sample-change listener calls preventDefault()

sampleRows.description: How many rows the sample run takes

cap.description: The spend cap – the run stops when it reaches it; null for none. Changed by its field unless a tc-cap-change listener calls preventDefault()

disabled.description: Start can't be pressed – while the app is starting the run, say

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price and amount

tokensIn.description: Average input tokens per cell – the prompt with the row filled in, plus anything looked up

RunEstimateColumn.description: One AI column of the run; its averages override the run's
